items.text: We are adding a bunch of cool new Quality-of-Life features, and fixing a few bugs. First off, we are adding Host Migration, which will prevent games from ending preemptively due to the host leaving. On top of that, we are adding a feature to change Neighbors mid-game, and adding Voice Chat. Time to polish up your home-invasion strategies!

Host Migration (When the host leaves, the game automatically assigns a new host, keeping the session alive instead of throwing all players out of the match. It will automatically pick the host with the best ping for everyone)

Dear Neighbors,
While we are waiting for the Robots to invade Heartsville early next year, we have decided to treat you with a balance pass, shorter matches and decoration for Christmas instead.

As you may know we are moving Neighbors into a more casual direction. This also goes for Destruction, but this time we have not touched the game mode, but rather done some initiatives on making it more fair to fight between each Neighbor and we have brought down the match length of each session.

We want fun, short and quick matches so you go in and have more fun regardless of when you join the game. And if you lose, well you just play again. So we have decided to bring down the match length by decreasing the health of fences, windows and house essentials and decreased the amount of House Essentials to destroy from 4->3. As always you can chose whatever you like from the custom settings.

Our logic, so far, has been to "punish" high-mobility Neighbors with low health or strength. We believe we have found a golden middle-ground, nerfing the mobility of especially PA and Kevin to some degree. On the contrary they now have a better chance in fighting all Neighbors.

The focus of this update has furthermore been to give Neighbors like MJ, Gramps and Cookie a better fighting chance against Neighbors like Doreen and Chad. This means that now it might actually be worth taking up a fight if you play a weaker character instead of running away. Kevin, Kim, Louie and PA has also gotten a bit stronger but has been nerfed a bit in mobility. It can be frustrating to have a Kevin or a PA on your roof every 30 seconds. Now this should not happen as often and hopefully it will concentrate some more fights around the front fences and windows. There will be more changes in future updates, going towards a generally more "balanced" experience. We are currently looking at giving melee possibilities to Gramps, Mary Jean and potentially also Louie. Feel free to comment your thoughts on this.

Based on the above and the fact that we try to drive Neighbors into a more casual experience, we have also decided lift the max cap of Neighbors pr. team by default. Now you can pick any character you like and try many weird and crazy combinations of Neighbors. We feel like we are able to do this because the Neighbors are more balanced now. At any time you can set the cap back to whatever you like, in the custom settings if you are looking for a more competitive or "fair" experience which is understandable but not the default intention from our side. If any completely crazy metas arise from this, we will do what we can to alleviate it.
Additionally, a lot of bugs and smaller annoyances has now been fixed, giving a more coherent and smooth experience! check out the full patch notes below!

Greeting's Neighbors!
We know it’s been a little quiet lately — most of the team took a short summer break to rest up and recharge.

However, while most of us were out catching some sun and touching some grass, our very own Erik (whose voice you are familiar with, since he is the announcer in the game) basically held down the fort on his own. Working closely with a lot you over on our discord, (big thanks - you know who you are) he kept on squeezing bugs and doing a ton of other small fixes over the last couple of weeks. The update focuses on quality-of-life fixes, balance adjustments, and gameplay polish as well as several long-requested tweaks from the community.

Greetings Neighbors!
It has been a while, but we've been hard at work to bring a big update and today we have a BIG one. Strap in, put on the sunscreen and make sure to always stay hydrated.

Today we are happy to release our second major update WELCOME TO PARADISE!! Grab a cold drink, chill at the beach and smash the lovely summer houses of your neighbors. Just a normal summer vacation in Heartsville i guess. 😎
WHAT IS IN THE UPDATE?
If you’d ask the residents of Heartsville, what’s the perfect place to enjoy the beautiful summer temperatures and refreshing sea breeze there is only one answer they'd give you: Paradise Cove.
Surrounded by palm trees and handcrafted tiki pillars is the perfect spot to catch some waves but beware since there have been sightings of hungry inhabitants of the sea.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/a2cde82ddc65d30c5ef7b444ccca08a66944398d.png"]Due to rowdy neighbors somehow you can always find a construction site in every neighborhood.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/1b34c34a7c5f22a1b24a8c62e36b17d8a001dbc3.png"]Handcrafted tiki pillars are disgusted by your lack of skill.
Paradise Cove will be playable in custom lobbies and in competitive queue.
Of course, a nice summer house is a key essential for every resident of Heartsville, which is why we are releasing not one, but two new houses to reinforce and defend.
Be it either the bamboo wrapped Tropical Retreat or the more sophisticated and pompous Sunset Villa. Either way you are going to enjoy your stay and love demolishing them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/389a678dabbb2b3ea0cf841d251a8e4fae6ca5d6.jpg"]If the Tropical Retreat doesn't scream OHANA for you...get help.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/a34fe1fa52db792e6c2277a3b778a3ee5372796e.png"]Tony Montana would be happy about the new Sunset Villa
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/8063d9ae3dfd5de8e92d6d1c2f226bef6a622179.png"]Our neighbors just hangin' around. And Gramps just casually wearing his Treasure Pirate costume.
In addition to the new houses we are also adding more customzation possibilities via skins. Of course they fit the vacation and beach vibes with Treasure Pirate Gramps leading the charge.

We’ve evaluated your feedback and concluded that removing the resources as a means to combat snowballing and the overall “sweatiness” of the game may have been a bit hasty. Although the criticism of our patch was very vocal, there were still players, who enjoyed the resource-less version of Destruction, since it provided a more relaxed playing environment. So overall the reception was mixed, which made reverting not really an option.
To provide the best experience for everyone we’ve made the decision to do two big changes:

We are bringing back the resource crates and create a dedicated matchmaking queue, which will feature a Global Leaderboard. This game mode will be accessible via the main menu and be the sorta default game mode for now.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/06c351df5ad10121be4eb749a21e7b0622a31c20.png"] Resource crates return to the Destruction game mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/426fb2026b4472c5804c05808096ca7330f8da18.png"] A global leaderboard will track the wins and reset periodically.
Casual gamemodes will be separated from the matchmaking queue and will only be playable via custom lobbies as our current server structure doesn't support two matchmaking queues.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/7af96142003225aa8d1e8935a46ba9fbb9fcada6.png"] Play! will now put players into a competitive queue with dedicated servers.

As mentioned in our Q&As our long-term goal for Neighbors is to bring in more game modes and possibly create a casual queue which will have all the fun party-ish game modes, but for the time being we decided to reserve matchmaking services for the competitive queue.

A new PvE based game mode is currently in the works and will be released after our company summer break and shortly after Gamescom 2025, where press and media will have a first look at it. We will share stuff as soon as possible. :)

Being in Early Access it is only natural for us to discover possible gaps in the overall gameplay flow as we move along the development plan. For this update we took some time to work on heavily requested features.

One being the most requested features is a more detailed breakdown of player performance in the scoreboard. We 100% understood the motivation for a Gramps player to see how much healing they provided or for a Kim player to see how much they have repaired throughout the match. Coming with this update you will be able to track these things via a short hit of the TAB button.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/4977a567da94fd303a478be343193f998e56ca81.png"]Scoreboard now features additional stats (Damage dealt, Healing provided, Structure damage dealt, Structure repair provided)
As the casual mode is being moved to local hosting we've updated the server list to display the selected game mode and also the server region for improved matchmaking. Long-term we have the hop
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/1cc494db8794ece19b9a7b5b5da674c74b500f02.png"]Servers will now display region and selected gamemodes.

The last but certainly not last quality of life update we are publishing with todays update is the implementation of an item hotbar, which displays all your items in your inventory and the connected hotkeys.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/38c12f5617c42b0630cdd98d6507312692b0bfda.png"]Handy dandy intenvory hotbary.

items.text: It's ya boi out here with a little hotfix for Patch #1 for all of you sassy peeps.

The biggest thing is that we are bringing back Baseball Pitchers inside. We decreased the amount of pitchers you can place close to each other, but we are still not there. We will be updating this functionality very soon.
In general we want to preserve the sense of you protecting/barricading your own house - but we do not want to create a fortress that is more annoying than fun.

Overall a lot of the patch is here to address some issues that caused some nasty crashes. I want to give some great appreciation to the Community, which were the ones that found the issue/gave us the lead so we could solve it. Keep up the good work!
Remember, the only good bug - is a dead bug!

Added back the functionality to place Baseball Pitchers inside the house. We also added new placement rules; these are still a work in progress and we will update the entire deployment system very soon.
You can now spin the character on the character screens to show off - weeeee
Increased the minimum damage of Kim's throwable wrench slightly - boink: Remember that if you can dodge a wrench you can dodge a juicy orange flying at mach 5
Slightly decreased the damage output of Louie Rocket Barrage perk
Fixed an error that could cause you to not being able to buy anything in the shop
Fixed a major crash where Louie’s rocket barrage perk could break the shop, sound and the world
Fixed an issue that would cause party invites to not being sent to your friends
Fixed other various crashes and matchmaking errors
David
Today, we are happy to say that we are releasing our first “real” update! Thank you for sticking with us and giving us your invaluable feedback during our early access!

Ever since the early stages of development we’ve wanted Neighbors to include a wide range of game modes and maps to offer more variety and make use of the opportunities we feel this universe has to offer. This update marks the first step in that direction.

Based on feedback received during the initial part of the Early Access release (as well as testing conducted with some of you) we have also made the decision to make changes to the base game mode, Destruction.
For a detailed breakdown of all the new things, read below! Otherwise we hope to see you in the neighborhood!
INVISIBLE WALLS

We are excited to introduce you to the new game mode Team Brawl! Set in our new map, The F.I.N.E Depot, it’s a team based deathmatch where first to 25 knockouts win. This is a new way to play Neighbors which we expect will make it into our other maps within long. Have a look below and don't hesitate to give feedback once you've tried it out!

Another significant change is that we are altering how resources work in our base game mode. Tiers in the shop now unlock automatically at night time, giving both teams a fair chance to obtain new items instead of the first team fight being all important. The resources will still spawn in the Construction Yard, but instead give money to the entire team when handed in.

This is our attempt at addressing some of the concerns related to snowballing and game complexity and was something that showed potential during a closed beta test. As always, we are listening intently with both ears to your feedback and are looking forward to see how this change affects your experience. If the change proves to work as we hope we expect to redesign the visuals of the resources to better reflect the new mechanics.

We have a long range of items lined up already. However, for this update we are happy to get the Pop Gun in the hands of our Neighbors. As a medium ranged Offensive weapon we can't wait to see what crazy plays will come out of it.
Detective P.A. has joined the shop to investigate the recent rise in crime and grindable Prototype Skins for select unique items have been added as the neighbors take the fight to the hardware store.
Aside from above features, we also have a lot of smaller additions, tweaks and fixes.
Expand the list below to see the full list of changes!

Hello Neighbors!
Update 3 is finally here and we are excited to bring new content and quality of life updates across the board. Today we are happy to release the third major content update HIDE THE COOKIES!
Big update time! Read on, or watch the video recap below.
Meet Cookie, Heartsville's newest resident!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/48f3e7ca825ffcfa63efca6a6fab2f03a4c1ed0c.png"]

Cookie is the neighborhoods infiltrator and saboteur. With her arsenal of scout skills and her trusty Multi-Tool, Cookie is ready to take out traps, disguise as a bush or tunnel her way across the Cul-De-Sac.
Attack: Cookie does a light melee attack.
Disassemble: Cookie Disassembles a trap in front of her, making her able to steal it.
Tunnel Digging (Default): Equip a shovel to dig a tunnel. When two tunnels have been placed, you can travel between them.
Camouflage (Level 5 unlock): Cookie gathers twigs and branches to quickly camouflage herself as a bush. She takes reduced damage while Camouflage is active.
Magpie Mayhem (Level 10 unlock): Cookie calls on her animal friends to protect her. Enemies that gets too close gets harassed by birds.
The new game mode Prop Hunt is here! Play hide-and-seek with your neighbors, where one team hides as props around the property, and the other tries to find and eliminate them before time runs out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/994ec702c1fcdff872bfcbd41429237140fab993.gif"]
NEW BRAWL MAP: Harmony Foundation
Harmony Foundation joins the neighborhood, as the new brawl map. This under-construction part of the neighborhood provides and all-new playground for knocking out your favorite frenemy neighbors.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/6a5be72ce0d5395bcf1c3fe60eed85fc5b5a8665.png"]
The Brawl gamemode will now be available in all existing maps, previously exclusive for the Destruction gamemode!

notes.title: Moving from dedicated servers to listen servers

items.text: In this update for are moving away from dedicated servers to make the creation and joining of different game modes more straightforward. We might get dedicated servers back in the future should the need arise but we felt this was the best way forward at this point in time. Together with the new replay functionality at the end of each match, we hope this will make it easier for people to find games, try out different game modes and have fun with their friends while we continue development!
(This change means that leaderboards will be temporarily removed from the game. We hope to have them back within long!)
In addition to the above, this update also brings with it a series of Quality of Life improvements and new customization.

notes.title: Doubled the amount of XP gained

items.text: This is a long overdue change. For a while now it has been clear that the progression in the game lacked balancing. We are taking steps to address that now. Moving forward all experience gained during play will be doubled.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/88a04e1a9f711f3489d01973175efe97e31bf3b6.png"]

Together with the new brawler map, this update also introduces increased spawn protection when playing in brawl mode. We hope this help to alleviate some of the pain points that has been reported from this game mode.

Several of the existing screen effects has had their visuals reworked. In addition, UI elements such as the ability icon and health bar have received additional functionality in order to make it easier for the players to understand and notice what is going on.
